messages:
Maya (SRE): Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. Need final status-page wording, decide who fields gated-RCA requests, assign owners for recurring-pattern work.

Jonah (Ops): I can own the public copy + 72h summary. Will push v1 by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Product): Public copy should be short + non-technical. Add one-line "what this means for you" and whether action is required.

Alex (Support): I'll assemble affected-customer list and outbound templates. Need final copy by tomorrow 2pm to send.

Maya (SRE): Proposal: publish a concise public summary on the status page; make the full RCA available on request to customers (gated via support). Ops to triage requests and log them in the tracker.

Jonah (Ops): Draft status copy (v0):
```
On Mar 23, a cache eviction config change caused a brief latency spike for a small subset of requests between 02:10-02:40 UTC. ~3% of requests saw higher latency. We reverted the change and deployed a patch. No customer data exposed.

What this means for you: no action required.

Customers who need a detailed technical RCA can request one via support; we aim to respond within 5 business days.
```

Maya (SRE): minor edits: replace "config change" with "configuration change" and add note: "we are investigating recurring cache churn patterns".

Priya (Product): Good. Add owner names in the internal tracker and a quarterly review task for recurring incidents. Owner: Priya + SRE lead.

postmortem-bot: Action items added: PM-3021, PM-3022. Link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/PM-3021

Alex (Support): I'll post the affected-list and templates to the secure doc and flag any enterprise customers for gated-RCA follow-up.

Maya (SRE): Owners & deadlines (proposed): fix + tests (Maya) - 10 business days; public status + 72h summary (Jonah) - 1 business day; outbound messages (Alex) - tomorrow 2pm; systemic incident-pattern review kickoff (Priya + Maya) - schedule in 2 weeks. I'll update the postmortem tracker with PR links once branches are open. Thanks everyone.
